Hi Jordan,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood Inference! We sent a temporary API key to your account and there are a few quick ways to get a tailored walkthrough:

- Book a 30-minute demo with one of our solutions engineers: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30min
- Explore the Quickstart guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart

If you'd like a custom session focused on latency or cost optimization, reply to this thread and one of our team members will follow up.

Cheers,
Redwood Team

- Tue Apr 6, 10:00–10:30 AM ET
- Wed Apr 7, 2:00–2:30 PM ET

If neither work, feel free to pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30min

Best,
